RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
REPRESENTATIVES OF COOLIES ATTACHED TO P.W.D. SAWGIN ROAD DEPOT ATTEMPT TO SUBMIT A PETITION TO MR. T.K. HO DEPUTY SECRETARY, S.M.C.
At ..20 p.m. 30-6-37, Inspector White and party of Police including D.S.I. Yang Fei Sheng and the under-signed attended Room 161, Administration Building with reference to two representatives, named Lee Kyung Tsung (李景春), r...D. Coolie No.46, residing Nyuin Yue Li, Tungchow Road Extension, Chapel, and Wang Tsau Shiu (孟招光), Nan Ching Road, Chapel, who were there on behalf of the highway coolies attached to Sawgin Road P.W.D. Depot (of which there were about ten or more waited on Hankow Road outside the Administration Building) to present two demands as follows:-
(1) That the highway coolies and sewerage coolies be issued with separate metal badges, as against that which is now the practice of issuing badges and numbers at random among them when congregating at the Depot for work each morning.
(2) That highway coolies continue to clean the highway drain sewerage instead of the sewerage coolies.
Mr. T.K. Ho declined to interview the representatives or consider their demands as same was not in accordance with his duties and did not concern him.
Representatives were informed to that effect and asked to go, this they did with no untoward occurrence.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Central Station, 72/2
REPORT
Date February 26, 1937.
Subject Reference P.W.D. coolies interviewing Mr. Yu Ya Ching.
Made by Insp. Browrigg Forwarded by Officer in charge.

Sir,
In accordance with your instructions the undersigned proceeded to Mr. Yu Ya Ching's office at 93 Canton Road at 3.30 pm. 26-2-37, to ascertain the nature of the interview sought by representatives of the P.W.D. coolies with Mr. Yu Ya Ching.
At 4.45 p.m. 26-2-37, the following representatives put in appearance:-
No. 57 Tsu Foo Yoong (蔡富榮)
No. 45 Li Kyung Sung (李景春)
No.210 Liu Fei Yung (劉煥文)
No.195 Kwei Boo Yang (蹼步瀛)
No.296 Wong Saung Zey (王双才)

It was ascertained by the undersigned that these men wished to see Mr. Yu Ya Ching to ask him to use his good offices in registering a protest on behalf of the Highway coolies of the P.W.D. owing to the new regulations regarding badges.
It appears that in the past the "Sewerage" coolies were issued with a yellow badge whilst the "Highways" coolies had a grey badge and in addition "Casual" coolies had a red badge. According to the representatives these badges are now going to be withdrawn and Green badges issued to both departments (Green badge shown to undersigned had "Highways" stamped upon same but representatives stated that the Green badges were all the same). The "Highways" coolies were now afraid that as "Road Repairs" by P.W.D. were now very seldom, that with the amalgamating of the two Departments "Sewerage & Highways" the "Highways" coolies would be made to suffer by utilizing "Sewerage" coolies when any work became necessary on roads instead of engaging "Highways" coolies to perform said work.

（印：K.B - 1 MAR）
（批：oc sp bx）
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER OF POLICE (DIVISIONAL)）

主题 关于公共工程部苦力代表会见虞洽卿先生一事。
由布朗里格（Browrigg）督察撰写 由主管警官转呈。

先生，
遵照您的指示，签署人于 1937 年 2 月 26 日下午 3 时 30 分前往广东路 93 号虞洽卿先生的办公室，以查明公共工程部苦力代表寻求会见虞洽卿先生的性质。
1937 年 2 月 26 日下午 4 时 45 分，下列代表出现：-
第 57 号 蔡富榮（Tsu Foo Yoong）
第 45 号 李景春（Li Kyung Sung）
第 210 号 劉煥文（Liu Fei Yung）
第 195 号 蹼步瀛（Kwei Boo Yang，音译）
第 296 号 王双才（Wong Saung Zey）

经签署人查明，这些人希望会见虞洽卿先生，请求他利用其影响力，代表公共工程部道路苦力就徽章新规提出抗议。
据悉，过去“下水道”苦力发放黄色徽章，而“道路”苦力发放灰色徽章，此外“临时”苦力发放红色徽章。据代表称，这些徽章现在将被收回，并向两个部门统一发放绿色徽章（向签署人展示的绿色徽章上印有“道路”字样，但代表声称所有绿色徽章都是一样的）。“道路”苦力现在担心，由于公共工程部的“道路维修”工作现在非常少，随着“下水道”和“道路”两个部门的合并，当道路需要进行任何工作时，将使用“下水道”苦力来代替雇佣“道路”苦力进行所述工作，从而使“道路”苦利益受损。

（印：K.B - 1 MAR）
（批：oc sp bx）
（印：警务处副总巡官（分区））

Strike of P.W.D. Road Construction Coolies
(Special Branch Intelligence Report 30-1-37)

At about 12.45p.m. Saturday, Jan. 30, 1937, about 60 coolies of the P.W.D., strikers, called at the office of Mr. Yu Ya Ching at No. 93 Canton Road to present a petition requesting the latter to intercede with the Shanghai Municipal Council on their behalf concerning the decision of the P.W.D. to introduce a new system for engagement of coolies.

Mr. Yu Ya Ching interviewed five of the strikers named (1) Wong Tsang Zai (王双才), No. 296, (2) Lieu Hwei Vung (刘焕文) No. 200, (3) Li Ching Tsung (李景春) No. 45, (4) Wei Boo Ying (步癮) No. 57 and (5) Tsai Foo Yeong (蔡福榮) No. 135 and stated that he would place the matter before the Council on Monday morning Feb. 1, 1937 and granted the five representatives permission to call on him again at 5p.m. same date.

The coolies then disperse quietly from the vicinity Inspector Everest and party of Police had attended from Central Station on the instruction of Officer i/c District.

This party of coolies previously called at No. 59 Hongkong Road, at about 12.30p.m. same day to interview a representative of the Chinese Rate-payers Association, however no responsible person could be located to interview two of the strikers who entered the building whereupon they left to call on Mr. Yu Ya Ching as mentioned.

1937 年 1 月 30 日星期六约中午 12 时 45 分，约 60 名公共工程部罢工苦力来到广东路 93 号虞洽卿先生的办公室，递交请愿书，请求后者就公共工程部决定实施新的苦力雇佣制度一事，代表他们向上海工部局进行调解。

虞洽卿先生接见了五名罢工者代表，分别是 (1) 王双才（Wong Tsang Zai），第 296 号，(2) 刘焕文（Lieu Hwei Vung），第 200 号，(3) 李景春（Li Ching Tsung），第 45 号，(4) 步癮（Wei Boo Ying，原文如此），第 57 号，以及 (5) 蔡福榮（Tsai Foo Yeong），第 135 号，并表示将于 1937 年 2 月 1 日星期一上午将此事项提交公董局审议，并允许这五名代表于同日下午 5 时再次前来拜访他。

SHANGHAI INTERNATIONAL SETTLEMENT ROAD CONSTRUCTION
COOLIES MUTUAL AID ASSOCIATION

REGULATIONS
---

Art. 1. The Association is formed by the road construction
coolies and so named the Shanghai International
Settlement Road Construction Coolies Mutual Aid
Association.

Art. 2. The Association will follow the Three Principles of
the People, promote friendship between coolies and
endeavour to improve their knowledge.

Art. 3. This Association is established at Lane 351, No.8
Elgin Road.

Art. 4. The Association will deal with the following:-

a/ to encourage the development of national spirit
in order to solidify the union of coolies.

b) to do its best to propagate the Three Principles
of the People.

c/ to exterminate injurious customs and habits and
to endeavour to facilitate the work of the coolies.

d) to establish a school for the coolies.

e) to improve the living conditions of the coolies.

f/ to protect coolies from being oppressed by their
employers.

g/ to establish a Labourers' Savings Society and
organize a coolies' Welfare Association.

h/ to deal with applications of members for financial
relief.

i) to mediate in all disputes between the coolies.

j/ to consider and act on any equitable suggestions
made by the coolies.

Art. 5. All road construction coolies who are in possession
of badges issued by the S.M.C. will be eligible to
join the Association.

Art. 6. Members of the Association will be entitled to the
following privileges:-

a) the power to vote and eligibility to the various
committees of the Association.

b/ The power to propose and to criticize.

c/ All other privileges mentioned in these regulations.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界筑路苦力互助会

章程
---

第一条. 本会由筑路苦力组成，命名为上海公共租界筑路苦力互助会。

第二条. 本会将遵循三民主义，促进苦力间的友谊，并致力于提高他们的知识水平。

第三条. 本会设立于爱文义路 8 号 351 弄。

第四条. 本会将处理以下事务：-

a/ 鼓励发扬民族精神，以巩固苦力的团结。

b) 尽力宣传三民主义。

c/ 革除有害的风俗习惯，并致力于便利苦力的工作。

d) 为苦力设立学校。

e) 改善苦力的生活条件。

f/ 保护苦力免受雇主的压迫。

g/ 建立劳工储蓄社并组织苦力福利会。

h/ 处理会员的经济救济申请。

i) 调解苦力之间的所有纠纷。

j/ 审议并采取行动落实苦力提出的任何合理建议。

第五条. 所有持有工部局颁发徽章的筑路苦力均有资格加入本会。

第六条. 本会会员享有以下特权：-

a) 投票权及当选为本会各委员会委员的资格。

b/ 提议权和批评权。

c/ 本章程规定的其他所有特权。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

Art. 7. The duties of every member will be to:-
a/ observe the regulations of the Association and
- its decisions.
b) attend meetings regularly.
c) pay membership fees punctually.
d) give advice to the Association freely on request.

Art. 8. Members who fail to observe the regulations and/or
decisions of the Association will be deprived of
special privileges and will be liable to be expelled
from membership of the organization.

Art. 9. The Association will have an executive committee of
29 members and 6 reserve members, all of whom will be
elected at a general meeting of the members.

Art. 10. The standing committee will be elected by the Executive
Committee.

Art. 11. The Association will establish five sections:-
1) The General Affairs Section.
2) The Organization "
3) The Propaganda "
4) The Mediation "
5) The Investigation "
each of which will be under the control of a chief and
a vice-chief who will be elected from members of the
executive committee.

Art. 12. Service on the various committees will be entirely
honorary and such term of service will be one year.
Committee members, however, will be eligible for re-
election at the end of each term of service.

Art. 13. Meetings of the Association:-
1/ There will be one general meeting in each year.
2) The Executive Committee will meet once a fortnight.
3) The Standing Committee will meet once in a week.

Art. 14. Any of the above committees will be empowered to call
a meeting at any other time should the business to
be transacted be of an urgent nature.

Art. 15. At all meetings of the Association the majority vote
required to carry a proposal put before the meeting
must consist of a number in excess of one half of
the attendance.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

第七条. 每位会员的义务为：-
a/ 遵守本会章程及其决议。
b) 定期出席会议。
c) 按时缴纳会费。
d) 应要求自由向本会提供建议。

第八条. 未能遵守本会章程及/或决议的会员将被剥夺特权，并可能被开除出会籍。

第九条. 本会将设有一个由 29 名委员和 6 名候补委员组成的执行委员会，所有委员均由会员大会选举产生。

第十条. 常务委员会将由执行委员会选举产生。

第十一条. 本会将设立五个部门：-
1) 总务部。
2) 组织部 "
3) 宣传部 "
4) 调解部 "
5) 调查部 "
每个部门将由一名主任和一名副主任领导，他们将从执行委员会委员中选举产生。

第十二条. 在各委员会的服务完全是荣誉性质的，任期为一年。然而，委员会成员在每届任期结束时均有资格连选连任。

第十三条. 本会会议：-
1/ 每年召开一次会员大会。
2) 执行委员会每两周开会一次。
3) 常务委员会每周开会一次。

第十四条. 如有紧急事务需要处理，上述任何委员会均有权在任何其他时间召开会议。

第十五条. 在本会所有会议上，通过提交会议的提案所需的多数票，必须超过出席人数的一半。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

Art. 16. Finances of the Association and Membership
fees

Members will be required to pay an entrance
fee of $1.00 and a weekly subscription of
$0.10.

Special contributions to the funds of the
Association may be raised at any time subject
to the approval of a majority of the
Association members.

Art. 17. The regulations governing the administration
of the various sections have yet to be drawn
up and will be separate from these regulations.

Art. 18. These regulations will come into force when they
have been passed by the first general meeting
of members.

P. T. O.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

第十六条. 本会财务及会费

会员需缴纳入会费 1.00 元，每周会费
0.10 元。

经本会多数会员批准，可随时为本会基金募集
特别捐款。

第十七条. 管理各部门的规章尚待制定，并将独立于
本章程之外。

第十八条. 本章程经首届会员大会通过后生效。

请翻页

page_data.en:
- 4 -

N.B.

The first duty of the Association will be to
carry out the work defined in Art. 4 of these regulations.
A portion of the membership fees received will
be allotted to a sinking fund for promoting the welfare
of the members.
(1) Members who sustain injury in the execution
of their duty or who are otherwise incapacitated through
sickness may apply to the Association for medical expenses.
(2) Members who contemplate marriage and members
who suffer the loss of a relative through death will be
entitled to a loan from the Association of an amount not
exceeding $100.00, the interest due on such loan to be
.5% per mensem.
(3) Where a member dies at an advanced age, his
heir may apply for a donation from the Association of
$100.00 to defray funeral expenses.
(4) The Association will open a free supplementary
school for its members.
(5) The Association will engage a legal advisor
to safeguard the rights of its members.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

注意

本会的首要职责是执行本章程第4条所规定的工作。
所收会费的一部分将拨入公积金，用于增进会员福利。
(1) 会员在执行职务中受伤，或因疾病导致其他丧失工作能力者，可向本会申请医疗费用。
(2) 拟结婚的会员及因亲属去世而遭受损失的会员，有权向本会申请不超过100.00美元的贷款，该贷款的利息为每月0.5%。
(3) 若会员高龄去世，其继承人可向本会申请100.00美元的捐款以支付丧葬费用。
(4) 本会将为其会员开设免费补习学校。
(5) 本会将聘请法律顾问以维护会员权益。

a Branch of the Peasants and Labourers Livelihood Improvement
Association.
Made by D.S.I. Laurier Forwarded by [Signature] Z.C/

The signboard entitled the "Branch Office of the
Shanghai Municipality Peasants and Labourers' Livelihood
Improvement Association" (上海農工生活改進會分辦事處),
hitherto exhibited in Lane 351, 8 Elgin Road, outside Chen
Kiu-feng's home was removed at 1 p.m. April 17, on the
instructions of Chen Kiu-feng.
The meeting of representatives of P.W.D. road
construction coolies, scheduled to take place at 6 p.m.
April 17 in Chen Kiu-feng's home, Lane 351, No.8 Elgin Road,
was not held as the result of action on the part of the
Police of West Hongkew Station who occupied the alleyway
and prohibited the workers' representatives from entering
Chen Kiu-feng's home. Chen Kiu-feng received a prior
warning from West Hongkew Station to cancel the meeting and
it is learned that he acted on this warning, but owing to
insufficient time being given he was unable to convey the
notice of cancellation to all concerned in time. Of the
40 persons who were turned away the following coolies were
recognised :-

at 5.45 p.m.

Section, came at 5.45 p.m.

Road Depot, came at 6 p.m.
Chang Zang-shing (張長興), ganger, Shunteh Road Depot,
came at 6.15 p.m. on a bicycle.
Shu Kiu-lung (許九龍), number unknown, Soochow

Subject...... Meeting of P.W.D. Road construction Coolies' Representatives at
the home of Chen Kiu Feng.
Made by... D.S.A. Laurier......... Forwarded by... J. Boyce D.S.I

Some 40 persons claiming to be representatives of the
coolies of the
P.W.D. (Shunteh Road Depot) held a meeting at 7 p.m. April 16
at No.8, Lane 351 Elgin Road, the residence of Chen Kiu Feng,
advisor to the P.W.D. Road Construction Coolies Mutual Aid
Association.

Chen presided and addressed the attendance stating that
as the Shanghai Municipal Police has prohibited the P.W.D.
Road Construction Coolies Mutual Aid Association from function-
ing in the Settlement, the Association had in consequence been
incorporated into the Peasants and Labourers Life Improvement
Association of which a branch had been established in the
Settlement. Coolies who wished to join the Branch were
required to observe its regulations and to unite
together in order to promote the welfare of the workers and
to protect themselves from being oppressed by the Authorities.
They would, however, be required to respect the wishes of the
Authorities and would not be permitted to utilize the
influence of the organization in furthering any unlawful
activities. Coolies and foremen should work together peace-
fully and not to resort to retaliative measures by reporting
each other to their foreign employers. In conclusion, Chen
requested the attendance to give their opinion on the subject.
As no suggestions were forthcoming the meeting was adjourned
at 7.50 p.m. when the coolies departed.

The following P.W.D. road construction coolies visited

约40名自称是工部局（顺泰路堆栈）苦力代表的人，于4月16日晚7点在爱尔近路351弄8号陈九峰住宅举行会议，陈九峰系工部局道路施工苦力互助会顾问。

陈主持会议并向与会者发表讲话，称由于上海公共租界工部局警务处禁止工部局道路施工苦力互助会在租界内活动，因此该会已并入农工生活改进会，并在租界内设立了分会。希望加入分会的苦力须遵守其规章，并团结起来以增进工人福利，保护自身免受当局压迫。然而，他们必须尊重当局的意愿，不得利用该组织的影响力推进任何非法活动。苦力和工头应和平共处，不得通过向外国雇主互相告发的方式采取报复措施。最后，陈请与会者就此议题发表意见。由于无人提出建议，会议于晚上7:50休会，苦力们随即散去。

        Mr. Wu Kai Sien, the leader of the local
Tangpu, was interviewed this morning and supplied with a
summarized account of the attached report re efforts of
Chen Kiu-feng to establish a branch office of the Peasants
and Labourers Life Improvement Association at 8/351 Elgin
Road in order to induce P.W.D. workers to join it.
        Mr. Wu stated that the Peasants and Labourers
Life Improvement Association is located in Nantao and is
a legitimate organization but there is no branch office
authorised in the Settlement. He will publish in the
Chinese press on April 15 a declaration to the effect that
no persons have ever been authorised to establish a branch
office of the Association.
        If the S.M.P. will write officially to the
Kuomintang Headquarters re the existence of the branch
office, the Tangpu will write to the Court or the Police
Bureau to take suppressive measures.

(4) Peasants and Labourers Life Improvement Association

   The following data concerning the above societies has
been obtained from Special Branch records and is forwarded
for information:-
   1) The Shang Yu Fellow Countrymen's Association, which was
formerly located at No. 602 Taepoo Road and which ceased
functioning in 1936, was under the direction of Chen Kiu-feng,
who was one of its committee members. In October and November
1934, this Association held several meetings in support of
Liang Tong Fong (梁桐芳), a member of the anti-Japanese
terrorist movement, who was arrested by the Shanghai Municipal
Police on October 19, 1934, in the Yoch Lai Dried Goods Shop,
354 Canton Road, and charged with attempted murder by throwing
a bomb.
   2) The Shanghai Municipality Servants' Employment Agencies
Federation was formed in November 1933 with offices at Lane
341, No. 5, Avenue Edward VII. This Federation, by its
activities, aroused opposition from the French Police. It
ceased functioning in March 1936, owing to lack of support.
   3) The Shanghai Municipality Tailor Shop Proprietors'
Association was formed in June 1932 and had a branch office
at the former address of the Shang Yu Fellow Countrymen's
Association, 602 Taepoo Road, with one Ho Yu Ching (何裕清)
as chief executive. The main offices of the Association
are located at the Shien Yuen Temple (仙缘), Siao Bi Loong,

Subject Activities of Chen Kiu-feng.

Made by G.D.I. Sih Tse-liang    Forwarded by J. Boyce D.S.I.

Following the receipt of instruction from the Shanghai
Municipal Police to cease his activities in forming the Inter-
national Settlement Road Construction Coolies' Mutual Aid
Society on March 8, Chen Kiu-feng (陳九峯 ) reluctantly
complied with the order by ostensibly announcing the cessation
of preparations for the formation of the Society and cancelling
the inaugural meeting of the Society, which was scheduled to
take place in the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, 480
Yu Ya Ching Road on March 14. This pretence however was kept
up for only a very short time in order to allay the attentions
of the Chinese Authorities for, about two weeks later he wrote
a letter ostensibly on behalf of the road construction coolies,
to the Municipal Council asking for permission for the formation
of the above Society. At the same time, he exhibited outside
his house the signboards of several other public organizations
some of which have long since ceased to function and others which
exist in name only. His object in the prominent display of
these signboards at his house is undoubtedly to mislead the
public and the Authorities by camouflaging his activities in
organizing the Road Construction Coolies' Mutual Aid Society.

He must be
checked

Realising the extreme difficulty with which he would have
to contend in obtaining the approval of the S.M.C. for the
Coolies' Mutual Aid Society, Chen now contemplates enlisting
the sympathy and influence of the Kuomintang in fostering his
movement for the exploitation of these coolies.

(印：OFFICE 14 APR. P.M. SHANG...)

The local Tangpu has under its control one organization
entitled the Peasants and Labourers Life Improvement Association
(農工生活改進會). It is to this Association that Chen has
turned for assistance. It is learned that he has submitted

A watch was maintained at Chen Kiu-feng's (陳九峰) house, Lane 351, No.8 Elgin Road, between 5 p.m. and 9 p.m. April 9 when the following persons were observed to enter the house :-
6.25 p.m. P.W.D. ranger/No.8 named Hsia Kuo-fu (夏國富) arrived.
6.40 p.m. Tai Foh Ziang (談福祥), P.W.D. foreman, Thorne Road Depot, arrived.
Both the above persons left the place at 7 p.m. by which time Chen Kiu-feng, who had left home earlier in the day, had not returned home. It has been ascertained that Chen Kiu-feng is busily engaged in the Chinese Ratepayers' Association election campaign. Subject Slight unrest amongst P.W.D. road construction coolies and the activities of Chen Kiu Feng.
Made by D.S.I. Laurier Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I

There are signs of unrest among the foremen and gangers of the P.W.D. road construction coolies attached to the Dixwell Road Depot in consequence of the dismissal on April 6 of foreman No.145, Hsu Kwei-hai (徐貴海) and also as a result of the new arrangement whereby the gangers receive only half a day's pay for those days on which work is suspended through inclement weather.

At 6.15 p.m. April 8, the dismissed foreman, No.145, accompanied by two foremen, named Kuh Ah Foh (古阿福) (Antung Road Depot) and Wong Hung Sung (王洪生) (Dixwell Road Depot) together with a ganger named Hsia Kai Fu (夏開富) (Dixwell Road Depot) called at Lane 351, No.8 Elgin Road with the object of consulting Chen Kiu Feng (陳九峰) on the matter.

Twelve P.W.D. road construction coolies subsequently called at the above address but owing to the absence of Chen Kiu Feng they dispersed without holding a meeting.

The following P.W.D. coolies called at the home of Chen Kiu Feng between the hours of 5 p.m. and 9 p.m. April 8:-

Made by D.S.I. Laurier Forwarded by J Bayne D S I

At 7 p.m. on April 3rd, nine P.W.D. Road Construction
Coolies called on Chen Kiu-feng(陳九峰), principal mover
in the formation of the P.W.D. Road Construction Coolies'
Mutual Aid Society, at his home at 8, Lane 351, Elgin Road, and
requested him to prepare for them a petition to be submitted
to Mr. Yu Ya Ching, Chinese member of the Council, soliciting
the latter's assistance in securing permission from the Council
to organize the above Society. It has also been learned that
a draft of this petition has already been prepared by Chen
Kiu-feng and is to be signed by twenty Coolies' representatives
and submitted to Mr. Yu Ya Ching through Chen Kiu-feng.

In view of the foregoing and pursuant to the action taken
by this branch on 8th March (vide report of 9th idem on the
subject) D.S.I. Laurier, after informing D.O."C" Division of
the proposed action, proceeded with Clerk Liao Chung Chien and
S.I. Brown of West Hongkew Station to 8, Lane 351, Elgin Road
and interviewed Tsu Lan Sung (朱蘭生), Secretary of the
above Association, in the absence of the principal, Chen Kiu-feng.

It was observed on entering the premises that the character
of the meeting hall mentioned in Special Branch report of 9th
March had in no way been altered apart from the fact that two
enframed certificates, made out in favour of the Welding
Factory Owners' Association, one of which was issued by the
local Tangpu on April 23, 1934 and which is in the nature of a
Certificate of Approval, were hanging on the wall.

Tsu Lan Sung, when questioned, denied that Chen Kiu-feng
had disregarded the warning issued to him by the police on 8th
March to cease his activities in the Settlement in the formation
of the above Society. He added, in extenuation, that since

经向前焊接社成员查询得知，该协会于1934年4月23日成立，办公地点位于通州路278号，即名为王荣棠（Wong Yong Tang）者的住址，王被选为协会会长，下设十六名委员。然而，由于缺乏资金支持，该协会被迫于1936年10月关闭，自该日起其活动已完全停止。
鉴于上述情况，陈九峯（Chen Kiu-feng）起初显然无意理会警方关于关闭集会大厅的要求，反而采取权宜之计，在墙上展示与现已解散的焊接社有关的证书，以掩盖大厅的实际用途，旨在消除人们对其活动真实性质的怀疑。
3月7日傍晚，对陈九峯的住所进行了监视，目的是进一步查明目前仅被怀疑在该处举行的会议的相关细节。当晚并未举行会议，但有几名工务局（P.W.D.）苦力造访该宅。附有一份列出他们到达和离开时间的清单。

Commencing from March 31, 1937, Chen Kiu-feng (陳九峯),
Committee Member of the 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation and principal advisor to the P.W.D. road construct-
ion coolies in their endeavour to organize a mutual aid society,
has secretly distributed some 800 membership badges of this
society to the road construction coolies. A specimen of this
badge is hereto attached.

It appears that Chen Kiu-feng and several representatives
of the coolies including Liu Hwan-yung (劉煥榮) (Coolie No. 200, Antung
Road Section), Kwan Boo-yuin (關布仁) (Coolie No. 195, Soochow Road
Depot) and Hsia Kuo-fu (夏國富) (Coolie No. 8, Dixwell Rd. Depot), in
defiance of the instructions of the Municipal Police issued
on March 8 ordering the cessation of the activities of the
Society, have, in spite of a temporary lull, resumed their
efforts to form an organization.

At present, the promoters are not active but are awaiting
a reply from the S.M.C. to a petition which they submitted in
the name of the Society on March 20, 1937 requesting permission
to organize a Society.

Chen's home located at No. 8, Lane 351, Elgin Road, is
used as a communication address, and as a place to which coolies'
representatives of various districts pay flying visits from time
to time. It has, however, been ascertained that his home has
not been the venue of a meeting.

自1937年3月31日起，第一特区市民联合会委员、工务局筑路苦力组织互助会的主要顾问陈九峯（陳九峯），已向筑路苦力秘密分发了约800枚该会的会员徽章。徽章样本附后。

看来，陈九峯与几名苦力代表，包括刘焕荣（劉煥榮）（苦力第200号，安东路段）、关布仁（關布仁）（苦力第195号，苏州路堆栈）和夏国富（夏國富）（苦力第8号，狄思威路堆栈），无视警务处于3月8日发布的责令停止该会活动的指令，尽管曾暂时沉寂，但仍恢复了组建组织的努力。

Secretary General

Translation of letter to Secretary General
and Mr. T.K. Ho from the International
Settlement Road Workers' Mutual Aid
Association.

Dated 20th March, 1937.

P.W.D. Road Workers: Proposed Association

In the spirit of mutual assistance and co-operation we, road
foremen and permanent workers, have organised this Association to
accelerate the speed of our work and to eradicate irregularities.
The Association is an advantage both to the Council and to the
workers. Because some unscrupulous person who schemed to obtain
irregular gains there has been some misunderstanding between the
workers and the Council. It was not until the Council declared
that it had no intention to reduce the number of workers that we
began to realise the situation. It is evident that the Chief
Foreman was responsible for the withholding the wages for the three
holidays and for the dismissal of workers on 30th January last.
To avoid misunderstanding and irregularities in future we beg to
state our object and plan as follows for your consideration:

a. Organisation and plan of work

1. The object in organising this Association is to foster fellow-
ship promote knowledge and the spirit of mutual respect and
assistance among its members.
2. Members of this Association are road workers (including fore-
men and permanent workers) employed by the Public Works Department
of the Council; non-workers are not eligible for membership.
3. This Association will endeavour to improve the quality of work
and accelerate the speed, to prevent irregularities, to promote the
welfare of road workers and to establish free schools, clinics,
loan offices, etc., for members.
4. The work of this Association is solely for the welfare of road
workers; it will never engage in politics.

b. Requirements of the Association

1. To guard against the Chief Foreman cutting down arbitrarily
the number of workers employed, and, to prevent irregularities.

秘书长

国际租界道路工人互助协会致秘书长
及何德奎（T.K. Ho）先生的信函译文。

日期：1937年3月20日。

工务局道路工人：拟议中的协会

本着互助合作的精神，我们道路领班和长期工人组织了本协会，以加快工作速度并杜绝违规行为。本协会对工部局和工人双方均有利。由于一些不法之徒图谋获取非法利益，导致工人与工部局之间产生了一些误解。直到工部局声明无意减少工人数量，我们才开始认清局势。显然，大领班应对扣留三个节假日的工资以及去年1月30日解雇工人的行为负责。为避免将来产生误解和违规行为，谨陈述我们的目标和计划如下，供贵方考虑：

a. 组织和工作计划

1. 组织本协会的目的是培养成员间的友谊，促进知识交流，弘扬相互尊重和互助的精神。
2. 本协会会员为由工部局工务局雇用的道路工人（包括领班和长期工人）；非工人不得入会。
3. 本协会将致力于提高工作质量并加快速度，防止违规行为，促进道路工人的福利，并为会员设立免费学校、诊所、借贷处等。
4. 本协会的工作 solely 为了道路工人的福利；绝不参与政治。

b. 协会的要求

1. 为防止大领班任意削减雇用工人数量，并防止违规行为。

page_data.en:
the Council is asked to issue numbered caps to workers.
We find that many former Chief foremen are very wealthy;
having become rich by forming a league with their subordinates
and falsely reporting more workers than the actual number employ-
ed. For instance, a piece of work at certain place may require
200 workers; the Chief foreman sends only 100 men to take up the
work. He obtains information beforehand and when it is proposed
to inspect his books and register, he temporarily engages a
sufficient number of loafers at 5 cents per capita to make up the
shortage. This dishonest practice has existed for a long time;
but unfortunately the Council is unaware of it. After the
establishment of this Association the Council will from time to
time be informed of all irregularities. If numbered caps are
issued, dishonesty may largely be eliminated.
2. From time to time the Council must send officers to the place
where work is proceeding to call the roll of workers, and then to
check the number with the number entered in the account book.
3. Rain coats to be issued to workers so that they may work in
rainy weather.
4. Foremen must not be held responsible for irregularities
committed by the workers. If a foreman does not satisfactorily
supervise his subordinates and his negligence is considered
punishable, a fine not exceeding one day's wage may be inflicted.
Formerly fines imposed on "iron-badge" foremen for negligence
while supervising workers amounted to seven days' wage. This is
excessive. Supposing a foreman is fined four times in a month,
it means that he receives no pay for that month which would be
unreasonable.
5. Unless a worker has made some serious mistake he must not
be discharged. If discharge is necessary, the facts of the case
must be announced to his fellow workers in justice to all, so
that misunderstanding may be avoided and the action serve as a
warning.
page_data.zh:
请工部局向工人发放编号帽。我们发现许多前任大领班非常富有；他们通过与下属结盟并虚报多于实际雇用工人数量的方式致富。例如，某地的一项工程可能需要200名工人；大领班只派遣100人去干活。他事先获得消息，当提议检查他的账簿和登记册时，他便临时以每人5分钱的价格雇佣足够数量的闲散人员来凑数。这种不诚实的做法已存在很久；但不幸的是，工部局对此并不知情。本协会成立后，将不时向工部局通报所有违规行为。如果发放编号帽，不诚实行为可在很大程度上消除。
2. 工部局必须不时派遣官员到工作地点点名工人，然后将人数与账簿中登记的人数进行核对。
3. 向工人发放雨衣，以便他们在雨天工作。
4. 领班不对工人犯下的违规行为负责。如果领班未能满意地监督其下属，且其疏忽被认为应受处罚，可处以不超过一天工资的罚款。以前，“铁牌”领班因监督工人疏忽而被处以的罚款高达七天工资。这过于严厉。假设一名领班在一个月内被罚款四次，意味着他当月没有收入，这是不合理的。
5. 除非工人犯了严重错误，否则不得将其解雇。如果必须解雇，必须向其他工友公布案件事实，以示公正，避免误解，并起到警示作用。

page_data.en:
6. When an extra "brass-badge" or "iron-badge" foreman is
required he must be chosen from among the road workers after
examination; this to encourage workers and prevent irregularities.
7. To avoid confusion the design of badges for road workers
should be different from those used by other workers. (The
Public Works Department recently proposed to change the road
workers' badges. We would not have objected were it not for
the fact that badges of the same design were also to be issued
to sewer workers; this being likely to lead to complications.
We have no wish to take over the work of others; neither do we
wish road-building work to be taken over by others; for purposes
of distinction different badges are necessary.)
8. The Council should issue a solatium for every road worker who
is injured or dies in the discharge of his duty.
9. A number of workers formerly employed to transport sand and
cobbles have been discharged; they should be reinstated.
(Five workers were formerly employed for each carload of cobbles;
that number has now been reduced to two, and they can only obtain
work for two or three days in a week. As a result, sand and
cobbles accumulate; the Chief foreman then invited a contractor
to undertake the transportation and he makes out false accounts
to enrich himself. The workers formerly engaged in transportation
have thus been deprived of their daily employment. We beg the
Council to abolish the contract system and have the transportation
done by workers daily appointed by the Public Works Department.)

9. Detailed statement of past facts

We road workers have mostly been employed by the Public Works
Department for a number of years and have rendered satisfactory
service. The Public Health Department arranged with a contractor
to undertake the work in connection with sewers for a period of
15 years. On expiry of the agreement in February this year, the
Sewerage Section of the Public Health Department was to be
page_data.zh:
6. 当需要额外的“铜牌”或“铁牌”领班时，必须经过考试从道路工人中选拔；以此鼓励工人并防止违规行为。
7. 为避免混淆，道路工人的徽章设计应与其他工人的徽章不同。（工务局最近提议更换道路工人的徽章。如果不是因为同样设计的徽章也将发给下水道工人，从而可能导致复杂情况，我们本不会反对。我们无意接管他人的工作；也不希望道路建设工作被他人接管；为了区分，不同的徽章是必要的。）
8. 工部局应向每一位在执行公务中受伤或死亡的道路工人发放抚恤金。
9. 以前雇用的一些运送沙石和鹅卵石的工人已被解雇；应当恢复他们的职位。（以前每车鹅卵石雇用五名工人；现在已减至两名，他们每周只能工作两三天。结果，沙石和鹅卵石堆积；大领班随后邀请承包商承担运输任务，并通过做假账中饱私囊。以前从事运输工作的工人因此失去了日常就业机会。恳请工部局废除承包制，改由工务局每日指派的工人进行运输。）

9. 过去事实的详细陈述

我们道路工人大多已在工务局受雇多年，并提供令人满意的服务。公共卫生局与承包商安排了一项为期15年的下水道相关工程合同。今年二月合同期满时，公共卫生局下水道科本应

page_data.en:
amalgamated with the Public Works Department; from that date no
work, except repairs, would be required for sewers. As the sewer
foreman feared that the 2000 workers under him might lose employ-
ment, he managed by using his influence with various parties to
oust the road workers so that the vacancies might be filled by his
own men. On 19th January the Public Works Department issued a

"This Department has been instructed by the Council to

Gangers $0.79 per day
Grade 1 coolies $0.65 per day.
Rubicon Sub-district:

与工务处合并；自该日起，除维修工作外，下水道不再需要其他工程。由于下水道工头担心其麾下的2000名工人可能失业，他便利用与各方的关系排挤道路工人，以便由其手下填补空缺。1月19日，工务处发布通知，以裁员为借口解雇道路工人；通知内容如下：

page_data.en:
Special Duty men:
Not more than 50 men in each area will be selected, by
merit, from artisans and Grade 1 coolies, for special duty
work and these men will be employed on a permanent weekly basis.
These will be trained men who show ability in their work. They
will be selected by the Assistant Engineer and Chief Inspector
of the area concerned. In their own interests coolies are
warned that the paying of gratuities, directly or indirectly,
to foreman or any other employes of the Council is unnecessary
and prohibited. Offenders will be dismissed. "
The road-workers were much alarmed by this notice, especially
by the rule that in each area there would be at most 50 workers
selected to perform special work'. The so-called special duty men
refer to us who number 1,200 permanent workers, 200 of whom are
occupied in each area. According to the new arrangement only 500
Class 1 workers, including road workers and artisans, were to be
selected. So besides the artisans, only over 20 of us would be
employed. Thus about 90% of the present number of workers would
be dismissed. There was consternation at such wholesale dismissals.
On 21st January 32 workers in Soochow Road district were suspended,
and badges for over 300 temporary workmen in Antung Road district
were withdrawn. This was actually what happened. The workers then
held several conferences and three representatives were elected
from each district. The representatives were sworn in and after
several days' discussions they agreed on 25th January to appeal to
the Citizens' Federation and the Chinese Ratepayers' Association
for assistance. On 27th of the same month, the Road Workers'
Mutual Aid Asso. was formed. A Manifesto was issued specifying the
seven reasons why workers should not be dismissed:-
1. Reduction of salary and staff should affect only senior officers
drawing salaries of several hundred to several thousands of dollars
per month.
-5-
page_data.zh:
特别勤务人员：
每个区域将从技工和一等苦力中择优选拔不超过50人从事特别勤务工作，这些人将以永久周薪制受雇。这些将是经过培训且在工作中表现出能力的人员。他们将由相关区域的助理工程师和总督察选拔。为了苦力自身的利益，特此警告：直接或间接向工头或工部局任何其他雇员支付酬金是不必要且被禁止的。违规者将被解雇。”
道路工人对此通知感到十分恐慌，尤其是关于“每个区域最多选拔50名工人从事特别工作”的规定。所谓的特别勤务人员指的是我们这1200名长期工人，其中每个区域有200人。根据新安排，仅从包括道路工人和技工在内的一等工人中选拔500人。因此，除了技工之外，我们之中仅有20多人会被留用。这意味着现有工人总数的约90%将被解雇。如此大规模的解雇引起了极大的震惊。1月21日，苏州路区有32名工人被停职，安东路区300多名临时工人的徽章被收回。这确实发生了。随后工人们举行了多次会议，每个区选举了三名代表。代表们宣誓就职，经过几天的讨论，他们于1月25日同意向市民联合会和华人纳税会求助。同月27日，成立了道路工人互助协会。并发布了一份宣言，列出了不应解雇工人的七条理由：
1. 减薪和裁减人员应只影响月薪数百至数千元的高级职员。
-5-

page_data.en:
2. The cause of economic depression is to be found in the
increase of unemployment.
3. Recently the Municipal roads have been extended and widened
and work on road building has increased daily.
4. As vehicles increase in numbers daily, and roads are
easily worn out and torn up there is much more repair work to
be done.
5. The original workers rendered meritorious service during the
Sino-Japanese hostilities in 1932, by working under showers of
bullets.
6. Very recently in all other professions wages have been in-
creased, but we have never asked for any increase.
7. To engage temporary workers will lead to abuses, and such
workers cannot be easily assembled.
The public being sympathetic towards us, feeling ran high.
Unexpectedly on the morning of 30th January the Soochow Road
district arbitrarily enforced the new regulations and dismissed
workers Nos. 170 and 171; a strike followed. The 1,200 road work-
ers elected representatives who appealed to the Citizens'
Federation, Chinese Ratepayers' Association, Chinese Co-
Secretary and Chinese Councillor Mr. Yu Yah-ching; on the
following day they appealed to the City Kuomintang Party
Headquarters, Bureau of Social Affairs, and the City Govt.
The proceedings which extended over four days were orderly,
and no incidents occurred. Mr. Yu Ya-ching having taken up
the matter with the Council, assembled the representatives of
roadworkers at offices of the San Peh Steam Navigation Co.
at 8 p.m. on 2nd February. After advising them to resume work
he replied to the representatives as follows:-
1. The Council has decided to deal with the matter according
to the old practice and will not reduce the staff.
2. Separate relief measures will be adopted if no work can be
done on account of rain or snow.
page_data.zh:
2. 经济萧条的原因在于失业人数的增加。
3. 近期市政道路不断延伸和拓宽，筑路工作量日益增加。
4. 随着车辆数量每日增加，道路容易磨损和破损，因此有更多的维修工作需要完成。
5. 原班工人在1932年中日冲突期间，曾在枪林弹雨下工作，立下了功劳。
6. 最近其他各行业的工资都有所增加，但我们从未要求过加薪。
7. 雇佣临时工人会导致弊端，且此类工人不易召集。
公众对我们表示同情，情绪高涨。出乎意料的是，1月30日上午，苏州路区擅自执行新规定，解雇了第170号和171号工人；随即引发了罢工。1200名道路工人选出代表，向市民联合会、华人纳税会、华洋秘书以及华人董事俞雅清先生求助；次日，他们又向市国民党党部、社会局和市政府求助。持续四天的过程秩序井然，未发生任何事件。俞雅清先生就此事宜与工部局交涉后，于2月2日晚8点在三北轮船公司办公室召集道路工人代表开会。在劝告他们复工后，他向代表们答复如下：
1. 工部局决定按旧例处理此事，不会裁减人员。
2. 如果因雨雪天气无法工作，将采取单独的救济措施。

page_data.en:
3. Road workers and sewer workers shall attend to their respective work and shall not interfere with each other.
4. The question of issuing numbered caps as a check against abuse may be taken up with the Council later.
5. The badges will not be changed, they will remain according to the old regulations.

The sole object of the representatives of road workers is to secure employment. They are satisfied since the workers are allowed to continue their work according to old regulations. On 3rd February, all the workers, including the 32 discharged, returned to work. The workers Nos. 170 and 179 resumed work at the same time, after Zi Mei-seng had provided them with temporary badges. The matter was thus completely settled.

During the strike, it was discovered that Zi-Mei-seng, a foreman in the Soochow Road district, had fraudulently kept back three days wages due to the workers for the New Year Holidays. After the Mutual Aid Association protested against this he agreed to release the full amount of the wages.

Over 300 temporary workers in the Antung Road district were discharged, and their badges have not yet been re-issued. They have appealed to the Citizens' Federation, the Chinese Rate-payers' Association and the Chinese Councillor Mr. Yu Ya-ching for assistance in recovering employment. On 18th February the following statement made by the Council was published in various newspapers:-

"Official statement made by the Council concerning discharge of road workers. Two weeks ago various Chinese newspapers reported that 90% of the road workers employed by the Public Works Department would be discharged. Yesterday and the day before yesterday the Press reported that the number of workers would be reduced by drawing lots on 20th February. These reports are absolutely incorrect.

-7-
page_data.zh:
3. 道路工人和下水道工人应各司其职，互不干扰。
4. 关于发放编号帽以防弊病的问题，可日后向工部局提出。
5. 徽章不予更换，仍按旧规执行。

道路工人代表的唯一目的是保障就业。既然允许工人按旧规继续工作，他们感到满意。2月3日，包括被解雇的32人在内的所有工人都恢复了工作。在资美生（音译）为他们提供临时徽章后，第170号和179号工人也同时复工。此事 thus 得到彻底解决。

在罢工期间，发现苏州路区工头资美生（音译）欺诈性地克扣了工人春节假期三天的工资。在互助协会提出抗议后，他同意全额发放工资。

安东路区的300多名临时工人被解雇，他们的徽章尚未重新发放。他们已向市民联合会、华人纳税会以及华人董事俞雅清先生求助，以协助恢复工作。2月18日，工部局的以下声明刊登在各家报纸上：

“工部局关于解雇道路工人的官方声明。两周前，多家中文报纸报道称，工务处雇佣的道路工人中有90%将被解雇。昨天和前天，媒体报道称将于2月20日通过抽签方式减少工人数量。这些报道完全不正确。

-7-

page_data.en:
Up to the present the Council has not intended to reduce
the number of road workers. The above reports are believed
to have been fabricated by certain individuals who alleged
that the Council was about to curtail the number of workers
but consented to make certain concessions as a result of
protest. The purpose of these false reports is to extort
money from the workers. The newspaper reports concerning
working time and wages are also at variance with facts.
In winter the workers work 8½ hours per day, and in summer
9 hours per day. The wages of first class workers are 65
cents per day; half that amount is paid to those who perform
no work on rainy days and holidays, and the full amount is
paid to those who work on such days. Each year three days
are allowed for the New Year holidays, and one day for the
Dragon Boat Festival. On such days full wages are paid and
those who work as usual on such occasions are given double
wages. These are facts."

According to the above statement, the Council does not
propose to reduce the number of roadworkers. How did it come
about that the Soochow Road and Antung Road workers were
discharged? It is believed that some foremen of the Works
Department, in league with each other, committed irregularities
to deceive their superiors and to oppress their subordinates,
and thus they brought about the discharges. How could the
workers know the intrigues of the foremen? The above mention-
ed reports were certainly not fabricated. An official
notification remains in a conspicuous position in the offices
of the Public Works Department. Has the Council not been
informed of this? As far as we know, the cause of the
discharges was that the drain workers were trying to take over
the work of the road workers. Evidence has lately been found
to prove this fact. There were originally 181 road workers
in the whole district of Tatung Road and Nanking Road; when
the old badges were changed for new ones, as many as 421 badges
were issued.
Apart from the

8.
page_data.zh:
截至目前，工部局无意减少道路工人的数量。上述报道被认为是由某些人捏造的，他们声称工部局即将削减工人数量，但因抗议而同意做出某些让步。这些虚假报道的目的是向工人勒索钱财。关于工作时间和工资的报纸报道也与事实不符。
冬季工人每天工作8½小时，夏季每天工作9小时。一等工人的工资为每天65分；在雨天和节假日不工作的人支付一半金额，而在这些日子工作的人支付全额。每年春节假期允许三天，端午节一天。在这些日子里支付全额工资，而在这些场合照常工作的人则给予双倍工资。这些都是事实。”

根据上述声明，工部局并不打算减少道路工人的数量。那么苏州路和安东路的工人是如何被解雇的呢？据信，工务处的一些工头相互勾结，弄虚作假以欺骗上级并压迫下属，从而导致了这次解雇。工人们怎能知晓工头的阴谋？上述提到的报道肯定不是捏造的。工务处办公室里显眼位置仍张贴着一份正式通知。工部局难道没有被告知此事吗？据我们所知，解雇的原因是下水道工人试图接管道路工人的工作。最近发现的证据证明了这一事实。在大通路和南京路整个区域，原本有181名道路工人；当旧徽章换成新徽章时，竟发出了421枚徽章。
除了

8.

page_data.en:
original 131 road workers, the remaining 210 workers are all drain
workers. Evidently the drain workers are trying to encroach on
the work of the road workers. Should trouble arise in future, how
will the road workers be distinguished from the drain workers?
We therefore elected representatives again to appeal to Mr. Yu Ya
Ching to ask the Council not to require a change in the badges. If
the change is deemed necessary, the drain workers and road workers
should be provided with different badges for the purpose of
identification. Specimens of three kinds of badges, viz: 1 New
Badge No.143, 2 Drain Workers' Badge No.296 and 3 Road Worker's
Badge No.87 were handed to Mr. Yu Ya Ching for investigation.

At that time the services of road workers Nos. 170 and 179 in
the Soochow Road district had been dispensed with. Neither the
foreigner nor the foreman admitted responsibility. The road workers
in that district, learning that these two workers were some time
ago the cause of a strike, and were now again discharged, proposed
to resume the strike. On being informed of the matter this
Association issued the following notice urging the workers to
peacefully carry on their duties and not to create any disturbance:

"According to a confidential report the cards belonging
to road workers Nos. 170 and 179 in the Soochow Road northern
district have been withdrawn by McLellan(?) and their ser-
vices ordered to be suspended, and the road workers in that
district have proposed to start a go-slow strike as a protest
against the action.

We find that sympathy should no doubt be extended to road
workers who are unreasonably discharged; but as the Council
has declared that it has no intention of reducing its staff;
the withdrawal of the cards must be due to some other reason.
We shall take the matter up with the Council and hope that
road workers will not create any disturbance in the meantime,

8.
page_data.zh:
原有的131名道路工人外，其余210名工人均为下水道工人。显然，下水道工人正试图侵占道路工人的工作。如果将来发生纠纷，如何区分道路工人和下水道工人？因此，我们再次选举代表向俞雅清先生求助，请求工部局不要要求更换徽章。如果认为有必要更换，应为下水道工人和道路工人提供不同的徽章以便识别。三种徽章的样本，即：1. 新徽章第143号，2. 下水道工人徽章第296号，3. 道路工人徽章第87号，已交给俞雅清先生调查。

当时，苏州路区第170号和179号道路工人的服务已被终止。无论是外籍主管还是工头都不承认责任。该区的道路工人得知这两名工人此前曾是罢工的起因，如今再次被解雇，便提议恢复罢工。本会在获悉此事后，发布了以下通知，敦促工人和平履行职责，不要制造任何骚乱：

“据机密报告，苏州路北区道路工人第170号和179号的卡片已被麦克莱伦（音译？）收回，并命令暂停其服务，该区的道路工人提议发起怠工罢工以抗议此举。

我们认为，对于被无理解雇的道路工人无疑应给予同情；但鉴于工部局已声明无意裁减人员，卡片的收回必定是出于其他原因。我们将就此事宜与工部局交涉，希望道路工人在此期间不要制造任何骚乱，

8.

page_data.en:
- 10 -

but peacefully carry on their work as usual pending a
settlement of the question."

Since the issue of the above notice road workers have all
kept quiet and we accordingly requested the Council not to dis-
charge the two workers. On the 8th instant, at roll call time,
the foreigner, Wetmore (?) falsely accused road worker No.296
in the Dixwell Road district of breach of regulations; the worker
was fined half a day's wages. As a matter of fact the case of
that worker was in the hands of Mr. Yu. The foreigner only did
this in spite, which provoked the road workers to go on strike.
As soon as the matter was made known to the Association the
workers were urged to resume work. Fortunately no untoward
incident occurred, and on the morning of the 9th work was resumed,
as usual. It was never expected that Wetmore would again charge
worker No.296 as the ringleader in the strike, and order him to be
discharged. This discharge would have culminated in a second gener-
al strike had it not been for the fact that warning had repeatedly
been given by this Association to the workers against creating
disturbances. The situation has remained calm; but in a state
of unrest we fear nothing can prevent trouble breaking out.
The above is an account of what has been going on.

The Secretary-General and Mr. T.K. Ho are asked to investigate
the above three questions and to deal with the matter step by
step.

(Chopped) International Settlement Road
Workers' Mutual Aid Association.

P.S. When the above letter was drafted but had not been sent out,
an official was sent by the Council's Political Section to the
Association to advise the discontinuance of all activities. On
receipt of these instructions, which we could not oppose, we
caused all meetings to be suspended and refrained from making any
page_data.zh:
- 10 -

而是平静地照常工作，以待该问题得到解决。”

自上述通告发布以来，筑路工人均保持安静，因此我们请求工部局不要解雇那两名工人。本月8日点名时，外籍职员 Wetmore（?）诬陷狄思威路区第296号筑路工人违反规章；该工人被罚款半日工资。事实上，该工人的案件正由于先生处理。此外籍职员此举纯属泄愤，从而激怒筑路工人举行罢工。此事一经本会知晓，即敦促工人复工。幸未发生不幸事件，9日上午已照常复工。未曾料想 Wetmore 竟再次指控第296号工人为罢工首领，并下令将其解雇。若非本会反复警告工人不得制造骚乱，此次解雇本会导致第二次总罢工。目前局势虽保持平静，但处于不安状态，我们担心无法防止麻烦爆发。以上为近期情况之陈述。

请秘书长与何德奎先生调查上述三个问题，并逐步处理此事。

（盖章）公共租界筑路工人互助会。

附言：此信草拟后尚未发出之际，工部局政治处派员至本会，建议停止一切活动。接到此项我们无法反对的指示后，我们暂停了所有会议，并避免发表任何

page_data.en:
statement. The purpose of organizing the Mutual Aid Association
is solely to promote the welfare of its members. Road workers
who have no connection with each other and are left without any
supervision, are joined together in a regular organisation which
will lead them along the regular track, thus enabling the
Authorities to easily exercise control, forestall unfortunate
incidents and prevent the men from being lured into wrong doing
by reactionaries. The advantages of such an organization can
therefore be easily seen. The Secretary-General and Mr. T.K.Ho
are asked to permit the formation of the Mutual Aid Association
under the direction of the Council. The Association will funct-
ion according to law, and will offer its co-operation.
Reply solicited.

(Note: Received for translation noon, Saturday, 20th March, 1937)
page_data.zh:
声明。组织互助会的目的纯粹是为了促进会员的福利。将彼此没有联系且缺乏监管的筑路工人联合成一个正规组织，引导他们走上正轨，从而使当局易于实施控制，预防不幸事件发生，并防止工人被反动分子诱入歧途。此种组织的好处由此可见一斑。请秘书长与何德奎先生允许在工部局的指导下成立互助会。本会将依法运作，并提供合作。
盼复。

（注：1937年3月20日，星期六，中午收到待译）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7758
S.I, Special Branch 3/7
REPORT
Date March 24, 1937.

Subject Allegations against certain foremen and gangers of
P.W.D. Road Construction Coolies.

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

With reference to the attached anonymous letter
containing allegations against certain foremen and gangers of
the P.W.D., regarding the formation of a union, I have to
report that of the six persons whose names are mentioned,
five are known to the Municipal Police, viz.

1. Wong Hong-sung (王洪生), foreman.
2. Chang Zang-shing (張長興), ganger.
3. Li Foh-ling (李福林), foreman.
4. Sung Yi-yoong (宋以榮), ganger.
5. Chu Kung-sung (朱根生), foreman.

Of the five persons listed above, four namely
Nos. 1, 2, 3 and 4, were among the representatives of the
coolies who were instrumental in forming the International
Settlement Road Construction Coolies' Mutual Aid Society in
January, 1937. The activities of these four representatives
were practically negligible, however, as the affairs of this
society were monopolized by the coolie representatives.

Their objects in participating in this movement
were for the purpose of appeasing the coolies and safeguarding
their own position.

Of these five persons, the remaining one, No.5, was
merely an ordinary member of the society and took no part in
its activities.

Subsequent to their learning that the existence of
this society was prohibited by the Municipal Authorities, all
these foremen and gangers have gladly severed their connections
with the organisation.

The writer of this anonymous letter gives his name
in the letter as "Tao Chah" (杜查) and cannot be identified.

（左侧批注及印章）：
C.P.
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 24 MAR 1937）
（手写批注：25/B）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 7758
S.I, 特别处 3/7
报告
日期 1937年3月24日。

主题 关于工务处筑路苦力某些工头及领班的指控。

由刑事侦缉督察施子良提出，经副侦探长 J. Boyne 转呈。

关于所附匿名信中对工务处某些工头及领班组建工会一事的指控，兹报告如下：信中提及的六人中，有五人为警务处所知，即：

1. 王洪生 (Wong Hong-sung)，工头。
2. 張長興 (Chang Zang-shing)，领班。
3. 李福林 (Li Foh-ling)，工头。
4. 宋以榮 (Sung Yi-yoong)，领班。
5. 朱根生 (Chu Kung-sung)，工头。

在上述五人中，第1、2、3和4号共四人，是1937年1月促成成立“公共租界筑路苦力互助社”的苦力代表中的成员。然而，这四名代表的活动实际上微不足道，因为该社事务被苦力代表们所垄断。

他们参与此运动的目的是为了安抚苦力并保障其自身地位。

在这五人中，剩余的第5号仅是该社的普通成员，并未参与其活动。

在得知市政当局禁止该社存在后，所有这些工头和领班都欣然切断了与该组织的联系。

这封匿名信的署名为“杜查” (Tao Chah)，身份无法确认。

（左侧批注及印章）：
C.P.
（印：特别处 / 上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1937年3月24日）
（手写批注：25/B）
S.I.
J.B.R.
25/3.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Station,
REPORT
Date
Subject
Made by,
Forwarded by,

- 2 -

As the Chinese character, "Tsz Chah", denotes "sensation"
or "feeling", there is every likelihood that there is no such
person in existence, bearing this name.

According to the postmark, the letter was posted
at 10 a.m. March 18, at the 9th Sub-Office of the Chinese
Post Office, located at Carter Road.

Discreet enquiries among foremen and coolies have
failed to elicit any trace of the writer of this letter or
information which may throw light on this complaint. There
is, however, some difference existing between the road
construction coolies and the sewerage coolies owing to the
former's strong objection to the latter's amalgamation with
them, through the adoption of a new badge.

The strong objection of the road construction
coolies to the change of badges may be attributed to the
belief that by the adoption of new badges, the sewerage coolies
who are permanent coolies will be automatically amalgamated
with the road construction coolies, who were originally on
the permanent staff. By this amalgamation, the road
construction coolies are of the opinion that they will lose
the preference to which, they consider they are entitled in
view of their former position.

Chen Kiu-feng (陳九峰 ), committee member of the
1st Special District Citizens' Federation, who was the

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by I. Bayne D.S.I.

Wong Shang-zai (王雙才), ex-coolie No.296 of the
Dixwell Road Depot visited the P.W.D. Administration building,
Hankow Road, at 10 a.m. March 13, 1937 for the purpose of
requesting reinstatement. Clerk Wong of the P.W.D. who
received him stated that as he had already appealed to Mr.
Yu Ya-ching for assistance it might help his case if he
could secure a letter of recommendation from Mr. Yu Ya-ching.
The ex-coolie then withdrew.
At 5 p.m. the same day Wong Shang-zai called upon Mr.
Yu Ya-ching at the San Peh Steamship Company, 93 Canton Road
and explained the situation to him. In reply Mr. Yu Ya-ching
promised to approach the P.W.D. authorities in the matter
and to give a reply in three days.
The $45 deposit money paid by the road construction
coolie to the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association for the
use of the hall was refunded to the coolies' delegation on
March 12.

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

At 3.30 p.m. March 11, 1937, Wong Shang-sai (王双才), the dismissed road construction coolie of the P.W.D. Dixwell Road Depot, accompanied by five coolies named Liu Hwan-yung (劉煥文) and Tsai Fu-yung (蔡富榮), both attached to Antung Road Section, and Sung Zoong-yuen (沈仲元), Hau Kiu-loong (許九龍) and Wong Lih-aung (王立生), who are attached to Shunteh Road Depot, called at the Secretariat of the S.M.C. Administration Building, with a view to obtaining an interview with Mr. T.K. Ho, Chinese Secretary. As Mr. Ho refused to receive them, they subsequently left and went to the San Peh Steamship Company, 93 Canton Road. At 3.45 p.m. Mr. Yu Ya Ching, Chinese councillor of the S.M.C., interviewed them, and during the interview they submitted the following requests :-
1. That the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association be urged to refund the $45 paid as deposit by the coolies for the use of the hall on March 14.
2. That the dismissed coolie be reinstated.
In reply, Mr. Yu promised to arrange with the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association for the refunding of the money and stated that with regard to the dismissal he had made enquiries at the P.W.D. and discovered that it was due to the coolie's failure to observe the rules of the Depot and that the coolies had instigated his colleagues to declare a strike. In conclusion Mr. Yu Ya Ching remarked that he was unable to do anything in the matter and advised the coolies not to create disturbances but to work peacefully and diligently. The delegation withdrew at 4.15 p.m.

（印：CIAL BRANCH 12 MAR 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

1937年3月11日下午3时30分，被工务局狄思威路（Dixwell Road）堆栈解雇的筑路苦力王双才（Wong Shang-sai），在五名苦力的陪同下，前往工部局行政大楼秘书处，要求面见华人秘书何德奎（T.K. Ho）先生。这五名苦力分别是：隶属于安通路（Antung Road）段的刘焕文（Liu Hwan-yung）和蔡富荣（Tsai Fu-yung），以及隶属于顺德路（Shunteh Road）堆栈的沈仲元（Sung Zoong-yuen）、许九龙（Hau Kiu-loong）和王立生（Wong Lih-aung）。由于何先生拒绝接见，他们随后离开，前往广东路93号三北轮船公司。下午3时45分，工部局华人董事虞洽卿（Yu Ya Ching）先生接见了他们。在会谈期间，他们提出了以下请求：
1. 敦促宁波同乡会退还苦力们为3月14日使用会所而支付的45美元押金。
2. 恢复被解雇苦力的职务。
作为答复，虞先生承诺将与宁波同乡会安排退款事宜，并表示关于解雇一事，他已向工务局查询，得知原因是该苦力未遵守堆栈规定，且该苦力煽动同事罢工。最后，虞洽卿先生表示他在此事上无能为力，并劝告苦力们不要制造骚乱，而要和平勤勉地工作。代表团于下午4时15分离去。

Subject Chen Kiu-feng (陈九峰)

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I

The watch on the movements of Chen Kiu-feng,
principal advisor to the International Settlement Road
Construction Coolies' Mutual Aid Society, was maintained
on March 10, 1937 with the following results :
At 11.45 a.m. March 10, Chen left the Chai Loh
Hotel, 250 Yu Yan Ching Road where he had stayed over
night. He returned to his home at Lane 351, No.8 Elgin
Road by ricksha.
At 7 p.m. he left home in his private ricsha No.8364
and arrived at the Chai Loh Hotel. Thirty minutes later he
left and went to the cabaret located in the Ta Fong Hotel,
31-33-35 Avenue Edward VII (French Concession). He stayed
there till 1.50 a.m. March 11, when he left and arrived at
his home at 2.05 a.m.
Enquiries made at the hotel reveal that he visited
the hotel in the morning to pay his bill.
During his stay at home during the day, road
construction coolie No.45 Li Ching-tsung (李景春 )
attached to Dixwell Road Depot, called on Chen at about
noon and enquired about the holding of the inaugural meeting
of the Coolies' Mutual Aid Society on March 14, 1937 in the
Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association. In reply Chen
stated that the plan for the meeting had been abandoned in
order to avoid further complications in view of the great
dissatisfaction of the Settlement Authorities towards the
Society following the rash conduct of coolie No.296 in
connection with his dismissal. He advised the caller to
solicit the assistance of Mr. Yu Ya Ching in obtaining the
$45.00 paid to the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association

主题 陈九峰 (Chen Kiu-feng)

制作人 C.D.I. 施子良 转呈人 J. Boyne D.S.I

1937年3月10日，对国际租界筑路苦力互助社主要顾问陈九峰的动向进行了监视，结果如下：
3月10日上午11时45分，陈离开其过夜的虞洽卿路250号柴洛酒店（Chai Loh Hotel）。他乘人力车回到爱文义路（Elgin Road）8号351弄的家中。
晚上7时，他乘坐私人人力车（编号8364）离家，抵达柴洛酒店。三十分钟后他离开，前往位于法租界爱德华七世路（Avenue Edward VII）31-33-35号大丰酒店内的舞厅。他一直待到3月11日凌晨1时50分才离开，并于凌晨2时05分回到家。
向酒店方面查询获悉，他上午曾到酒店结账。
白天他在家期间，隶属于狄思威路堆栈的筑路苦力第45号李景春（Li Ching-tsung）于中午左右拜访陈，询问关于1937年3月14日在宁波同乡会举行苦力互助社成立大会的事宜。陈回答说，鉴于第296号苦力因被解雇一事行为鲁莽，导致租界当局对该社极为不满，为避免进一步复杂化，已放弃开会计划。他建议来访者寻求虞洽卿先生的帮助，以索回支付给宁波同乡会的45.00美元

as deposit for the hire of the hall for the meeting. In
conclusion Chen Kiu-feng remarked that it was not advisable
for the coolies to make frequent visits to his address in

At 7 p.m. March 10, some ten coolies attached to
the Shun Teh Road Depot visited Chen's home for the purpose
of discussing a private quarrel between a coolie and a
ganger. On the advice of Chen, these coolies did not hold
a discussion but left his house.
According to information received, Chen Kiu-feng
has agreed to dissolve the Road Construction Coolies' Mutual
Aid Society, but dare not inform the coolies of his decision,
partly because he will "lose face" and partly because he
fears the coolies will take action against him. He has
already collected a sum of more than $1,000 from coolies
to defray the expenses of the Society. Of this sum, $600
has been spent in furnishing the house accommodating the
office of the Society, and providing funds for the printed
propaganda. If he announces the dissolution of the Society,
the coolies will naturally demand the refunding of the money,
and Chen is not in a position to comply with this demand.
He is now hoping that the Society will die a natural death.

Chapei District Squatters' Federation - Inaugurated

A new organization entitled the "Chapei District
Squatters' Federation" was formally inaugurated at 2 p.m.
March 8 in a hut situated at the corner of Chung Hwa
Sing Road, and Pu Zuan Road, Chapei. This organization
is directed by Chen Kiu-feng, a committee member of the
First Special District Citizens' Federation.

The following squatters form the Standing
Committee of the Federation :-

Liu Feng-san (刘凤山)
Li Teh-chong (李德昌)
Liu Tsing-siu (刘进修)
Fee Tuh-yu (费德裕)
Wong Chi-an (王其安)

Out of 20,000 squatter families, about 400
are members. The Federation plans to collect $0.10
every month from each family for the purpose of
conducting welfare enterprises among the squatters.

闸北区棚户联合会 - 成立

一个名为“闸北区棚户联合会”的新组织于3月8日下午2时在闸北中华新路（Chung Hwa Sing Road）与普善路（Pu Zuan Road）转角处的一间棚屋内正式成立。该组织由第一特区市民联合会委员陈九峰领导。

以下棚户组成联合会常务委员会：

刘凤山 (Liu Feng-san)
李德昌 (Li Teh-chong)
刘进修 (Liu Tsing-siu)
费德裕 (Fee Tuh-yu)
王其安 (Wong Chi-an)

在两万户棚户家庭中，约有400户是会员。联合会计划每月从每户收取0.10美元，用于在棚户中开展福利事业。

Subject Chen Kiu-feng (陳九峯).
Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by J. Boyne & S.I.

A close watch was maintained on March 9 on the
movements of Chen Kiu-feng, principal advisor to the
International Settlement Road Construction Coolies Mutual
Aid Society, with the following results :-
He remained at his home at Lane 351, No.8 Elgin
Road, until 3.15 p.m. when he left in a Johnson hire car
No.18599. Discreet enquiries subsequently made elicited
the information that he was proceeding to see squatters on
Chung Hwa Sing Road, Chapei.
He was later located on Chung Hwa Sing Road,
Chapei, where he was addressing some 70 squatters.
At 4 p.m. he left Chapei in a ricksha and went to
the Chinese Ratepayers' Association, 59 Hongkong Road. He
left at 5.20 p.m.
At 5.45 p.m. he arrived at the Chai Loh Hotel,
250 Yu Ya Ching Road, and hired Room No.118, where he stayed
throughout the night. According to the employees of the
hotel, he received no visitors of the coolie type.
However, during the evening of March 9, 1937,
Yu Yao-chiu (余耀球), a member of the local Tangpu, called
on Chen at the hotel and conveyed to him the Tangpu's
decision forbidding the organization of the Coolies' Mutual
Aid Society, and instructing him to sever his relations
with the coolies. In reply, Chen stated that he had no
desire to organize the Society and that in order to avoid
further connection with the coolies he intended not to
return home for a few days. In conclusion he remarked that
coolies of all depots were peaceful except those of the
Dixwell Road Depot, among whom were some fiery tempered

3月9日，对国际租界筑路苦力互助社主要顾问陈九峰的动向进行了严密监视，结果如下：
他一直待在爱文义路（Elgin Road）8号351弄的家中，直到下午3时15分，他乘坐一辆约翰逊出租车（编号18599）离开。随后的谨慎查询获悉，他正前往闸北中华新路看望棚户。
后来他在闸北中华新路被发现，当时他正在向约70名棚户发表讲话。
下午4时，他乘人力车离开闸北，前往香港路59号华人纳税会。他于下午5时20分离开。
下午5时45分，他抵达虞洽卿路250号柴洛酒店，租下118号房间，并在那里过夜。据酒店员工称，他没有接待任何苦力类型的访客。
然而，在1937年3月9日晚，当地塘浦成员余耀球（Yu Yao-chiu）到酒店拜访陈，并向他传达了塘浦禁止组织苦力互助社的决定，指示他与苦力断绝关系。陈回答说，他无意组织该社，并且为了避免费与苦力有进一步牵连，他打算几天不回家。最后他表示，各堆栈的苦力都很平静，除了狄思威路堆栈的苦力，其中有一些脾气火爆的人

Subject P.W.D. Road Construction Coolies - Unrest.

Made by C.D.I. Shih Tse Liang, Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I

At about 7 p.m. March 8, 1937, some thirty road construction
coolies gathered at the office of the International Settlement
Road Construction Coolies' Mutual Aid Society, Lane 351, No.8
Sighin Road. Half an hour later Chen Kiu Feng (陈九峰),
principal advisor to the society, addressed the attendance
stating that they should not resort to a declaration of a strike
as a demonstration of their grievance, but always refer the
dispute to Mr. Yu Yah Ching, Chinese member of the S.M.C. for
negotiation. Coolie No.296 Wong Saung Zai (黄双才) who was
the cause of the dispute at Dixwell Road Depot on the morning
of March 8 which resulted in a transient strike of coolies at
the depot, declared that the coolies went on strike of their
own accord and later resumed on his persuasion. He promised to
be careful in future. The coolies dispersed at 7.40 p.m. with-
out arriving at any decision.

Addressing the gathering, Chen Kiu Feng made no reference
to the order he had received from the police to close the
office and remove the society from the Settlement.

At 6.30 a.m. March 9, when coolies were attending the
morning roll call at the Dixwell Road Depot, the P.W.D.
authorities announced the dismissal of Coolie No.296 Wong
Saung Zai. After a brief argument with the P.W.D. authorities,
the dismissed coolie left the depot. At 8 a.m. he arrived at
the office of the society and interviewed Chen Kiu Feng to whom
he explained the recent development. Chen advised him to
summon all delegates and call on Mr. Yu Yah Ching at his office
in the San Peh Steamship Navigation Co., 93 Canton Road during
the afternoon March 9, 1937 for the purpose of enlisting his
assistance in securing re-instatement. Chen added that

主题 工务局筑路苦力 - 动荡。

制作人 C.D.I. 施子良，转呈人 J. Boyne D.S.I

1937年3月8日晚上7时左右，约三十名筑路苦力聚集在国际租界筑路苦力互助社办公室，地址为爱文义路（Sighin Road，原文拼写有误，应为Elgin Road）8号351弄。半小时后，该社主要顾问陈九峰向在场人员发表讲话，指出他们不应以宣布罢工来抗议不满，而应始终将争议提交给工部局华人董事虞洽卿先生进行谈判。第296号苦力黄双才（Wong Saung Zai）是3月8日上午狄思威路堆栈纠纷的起因，该纠纷导致堆栈苦力短暂罢工，他声称苦力是自愿罢工的，后来在他的劝说下复工。他承诺今后会小心行事。苦力们在晚上7时40分散去，未达成任何决定。

陈九峰在向集会发表讲话时，未提及他收到的警方命令，即关闭办公室并将社团迁出租界。

3月9日上午6时30分，当苦力们在狄思威路堆栈参加晨间点名时，工务局当局宣布解雇第296号苦力黄双才。在与工务局当局简短争论后，被解雇的苦力离开了堆栈。上午8时，他到达社团办公室并面见陈九峰，向他解释了最近的事态发展。陈建议他召集所有代表，并于1937年3月9日下午前往广东路93号三北轮船航运公司虞洽卿先生的办公室，寻求他的帮助以争取复职。陈补充说

DISRUPTION OF WORK BY P.W.D.
ROAD CONSTRUCTION COOLIES

Vide Morning State dated March 8, 1937:-

At 8.45 a.m. on the advice of a representative of the
Road Construction Coolies Mutual Aid Society work was resumed
by the Road Construction Coolies attached to the P.W.D. Depot
Dixwell Road.

SITUATION A.M. 9-3-37.

At 6.30 a.m. 9-3-37 at the Dixwell Road Depot Mr. Law
P.W.D. dismissed from work coolie No.296. This coolie following
dismissal left the Depot closely followed by Police, and a large
gathering of coolies.

The gathering walked along Dixwell Road to Yalu Road where,
coolie No.296 jumped onto a passing P.W.D. lorry proceeding
towards Point Road.

The coolies, numbering about 100, who had followed 296
then dispersed and returned to their respective jobs of work.

C.D.I. Ross.

Inspector.

Date March 9, 1937.

Subject S.M.P. warning to the Shanghai International Settlement Road Construction Coolies' Mutual Aid Society (unlicensed) to cease functioning in the Settlement.

Made by D.S.I. Laurier Forwarded by J. Logan D.S.I.

With reference to the report of March 8th on the transient strike of the P.W.D. road construction coolies, and the activities of the Shanghai International Settlement road construction Coolies' Mutual Aid Society; the illegal nature of this organization's functions, and the Labour Law which the existence of the society contravenes, were communicated to D.O./Division.

On the instructions of the D.O. "C" Division, the Inspector in charge of West Hongkew Station, at 5 p.m. on March 8th, accompanied by a party of uniformed police, proceeded to the offices of the above Society, situated at House 8, Lane 351, Elgin Road.

No signboard or other indication of the Society's activities could be seen over the door of the house or in the lane leading to it.

It was ascertained, on entering, that the premises are occupied by one Chen Kiu Feng (陈九峰), President of the Society, and his family, who live on the first floor. The ground floor is taken up with a kitchen, in rear of the building, and an office, adjoining which is a large room where the meetings of the Society are held. This room contains four tables, placed end to end, around which are arranged 13 chairs, whilst two rows, each of 9 cane-seated stools, are ranged along the sides of two walls. The room appears to have been recently renovated: the furniture is new and a large electric chandelier hanging from the centre of the ceiling, and two electric lamp brackets on the walls appear to have been recently installed.

Chen Kiu-feng (陳九峰 ), principal advisor to
the S.M.C. Road Construction Coolies' Mutual Aid Society,
is a committee member of the 5th District Branch Citizens'
Association, and the 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation, North Soochow Road. He is also on the committee
of the Chinese Ratepayers' Association, Hongkong Road.
His past activities may be summarised as follows :-
He participated in the activities of the Committee
of Various Bodies to Support Patriots, organized by the 1st
Special District Citizens' Federation, in connection with
the arrest and conviction of persons by the Municipal Police
for bomb-throwing.
In December, 1936, he promoted the Leather Article
Workshop Owners' Association, located at Ping Tsz Zoe Club,
Yunnan Road. His activities were cut short owing to the
strong opposition of the traders concerned, on the ground
that he himself was not a leather article trader.
He was a member of the Smuggling Prevention Society
of Shanghai Various Circles organized at a meeting held on
June 24, 1936, by the 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation.
He was advisor to the squatters in the Eastern and
Western Districts in forming the Shanghai Municipality
Squatters' Federation in 1936 and in opposing the decision
of the S.M.C. to demolish squatters' huts.
As far as can be ascertained, Chen Kiu-feng has no
regular employment or business, and appears to obtain his
living by taking advantage of opportunities to form organisations.

Subject Arrest of three P.W.D. coolies at West Hongkew Station.

Made by D.P.S. Henchman Forwarded by J. Payne. D.S.I.

On the early morning of 8th March a dispute occurred at
the Dixwell Road P.W.D. Depot between road construction coolie
No.296 Wong Saung Lai (王才) and P.W.D. Inspector J. Weidman.
This dispute arose as a result of the P.W.D. Inspector's
refusal to give employment to coolie No.296, who had recently
been suspended, and was the cause of a "tai-kung" strike of a
few hours duration, the coolies refusing to go to work as a
protest against the inspector's action.
Coolie No.296 having been refused employment went to the
offices of the P.W.D. Road Construction Coolies Mutual Aid
Society on Elgin Road and stated his case. It appears that he
received little sympathy and was told that the remainder of the
coolies at the Dixwell Road Depot would at once resume work.
(The coolies resumed work at 8.45 a.m.)
After visiting the offices of his association Coolie No.296
announced his intention of returning to his home at 407 Jansen
Road, but while passing West Hongkew Station he stopped to
speak to a number of P.W.D. road construction coolies who were
working outside Police Station. S.I.C. 662 who was standing at
the entrance of the station witnessed the arrival of coolie
No.296 and saw the coolies gather round him. Anxious to find
out what was going on he approached the coolies and overheard
coolie No.296 use the Chinese word for strike, "Bo-Kung" (罢工).
Thinking that No.296 was endeavouring to induce the other
coolies to strike he spoke to him, but was told not to interfere.
S.I.C. 662 then arrested the man and took him inside the Station.
Shortly after two other road construction coolies, No.107
Zu Yung San (朱荣山), and No.275, Wong Yung Sung (王荣松),
were arrested for loitering outside the West Hongkew Station,

主题 在西虹口警署逮捕三名工务局苦力。

制作人 副巡官 Henchman 转交人 J. Payne. 副高级督察

3月8日凌晨，在狄思威路工务局堆栈，筑路苦力第296号王才 (王才) 与工务局巡官 J. Weidman 之间发生争执。这场争执是由于工务局巡官拒绝雇用最近被停职的第296号苦力引起的，这导致了一场持续几小时的“怠工”罢工，苦力们拒绝上班以抗议巡官的行动。
第296号苦力在被拒绝雇用后，前往爱而近路的工务局筑路苦力互助会办公室陈述了他的情况。看来他几乎没有得到同情，并被告知狄思威路堆栈的其余苦力将立即恢复工作。（苦力们于上午8点45分恢复了工作。）
在拜访了他的协会办公室后，第296号苦力宣布打算返回他在贾森路407号的家，但在经过西虹口警署时，他停下来与几名在警察局外工作的工务局筑路苦力交谈。站在警局门口的警员 662 号目睹了第296号苦力的到来，并看到苦力们围在他身边。急于弄清发生了什么，他走近苦力们，无意中听到第296号苦力使用了中文“罢工” (Bo-Kung) 一词。
认为第296号正试图诱使其他苦力罢工，他便与其交谈，但被告知不要干涉。
随后，警员 662 号逮捕了该男子并将其带入警局内。
不久之后，另外两名筑路苦力，第107号朱荣山 (朱荣山) 和第275号王荣松 (王荣松)，因在西虹口警署外游荡而被捕，

Subject Transient strike of P.W.D. road construction coolies at the
Dixwell Road Depot.

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by J Boyne D S I

At 6.30 a.m. March 8, 1937, when the road construction
coolies of the P.W.D. Dixwell Road Depot attended the morning
roll-call, coolie No.296 Wong Saung-zai (王双全), who had
been suspended for the past few days for failing to produce
his working badge, arrived. Instead of taking up his usual
position in the line of coolies, coolie No.296 approached Mr.
Weidman, P.W.D. Inspector, who was superintending the roll-call,
and demanded that he should be given work. Mr. Weidman told
the coolie that if he wanted to work, he must take his place in
the line of coolies. This the coolie refused to do and as a
result was told he would be fined a sum equivalent to 1/4 day's
pay. The coolie then declared that he would not accept this
punishment and in consequence was told by Mr. Weidman that he
would not be given work for the day in question, March 8. This
decision of the P.W.D. Inspector caused general dissatisfaction
among the remainder of the coolies who, as a protest, refused
to go to work and at 7 p.m. declared a "tai-kung" strike.
The strike was, however, called off at 8.45 a.m. on the
advice of a messenger from the Shanghai International Settlement
Road Construction Coolies' Mutual Aid Society.
It is learned that representatives of the coolies will
hold an urgent meeting in the office of the Society, Lane 351,
No.8 Elgin Road at 6 p.m. March 8, to discuss the matter.
Copies of a notice announcing the inaugural meeting
of the Mutual Aid Society at 2 p.m. March 14, in the Ningpo
Fellow Countrymen's Association, and admission tickets to the
meeting, were distributed among the P.W.D. road construction
coolies on the afternoon of March 7.

主题 工务局狄克威尔路堆栈筑路苦力的短暂罢工。

由 刑事侦缉督察 施子良（Sih Tse-liang）制作 经由 副督察 J Boyne 转呈

1937年3月8日上午6时30分，当工务局狄克威尔路堆栈的筑路苦力参加早点名时，因未出示工作证而被停职数日的第296号苦力王双全（Wong Saung-zai）到场。第296号苦力没有像往常一样站在苦力队伍中，而是走向正在监督点名的工务局督察魏德曼（Weidman）先生，并要求给予工作。魏德曼先生告诉该苦力，如果想工作，必须站到苦力队伍中去。该苦力拒绝这样做，结果被告知将被处以相当于四分之一日薪的罚款。该苦力随即声明不接受此处罚，因此魏德曼先生告知他，在当天即3月8日将不给他工作。工务局督察的这一决定引起了其余苦力的普遍不满，他们作为抗议，拒绝上班，并于上午7时宣布举行“怠工”罢工。
然而，在上海公共租界筑路苦力互助会信使的建议下，罢工于上午8时45分取消。
据悉，苦力代表将于1937年3月8日下午6时在埃尔金路（Elgin Road）8号351弄的互助会办公室举行紧急会议，讨论此事。
宣布互助会于3月14日下午2时在宁波同乡会举行成立大会的通知副本及入场券，已于3月7日下午分发给工务局筑路苦力。

S.I, Special Branch Alibih,
REPORT
Date March 7, 1937.

Subject Activities of P.W.D. Road Construction Coolies.

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tae-liang Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.J

Between 7 p.m. and 9 p.m. March 5, 1937, some
twenty representatives of the P.W.D. road construction
coolies, gangers and foremen held a meeting at the office
of the Coolies' Mutual Aid Society at Lane 351, house No.8
Elgin Road, to discuss the plan of forming the coolies,
gangers and foremen into a Mutual Aid Society. Chen Kiu-
feng (陳九峰), principal adviser to the coolies, stated
that he would assume full responsibility and lead them in
the movement. He also promised that he would never be
influenced by an outsider to change his decision. The
representatives of the road construction coolies then
requested Chen to ask Mr. Yu Ya Ching, Chinese councillor
of the S.M.C., to return the coolies' badges which were
loaned to him as specimens a few days ago. Chen agreed to
look into this matter. Finally it was decided to hold the
inaugural meeting of the Mutual Aid Society at 2 p.m. March
14 in the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association, 480 Ya
Ya Ching Road.

Mimeographed copies of the following notices were
given to those present to be distributed among their
colleagues :-

1) Notification No.3 of the Shanghai International
Settlement Road Construction Coolies' Mutual Aid
Society.

2) Draft of an agreement between road construction
coolies and foremen of the P.W.D.

Translations of both pamphlets are attached to this report.

（左侧批注：C.P. / 93 / D.C.(O) / D.C.(C)）

Notification No.3 of the Shanghai International Settlement
Road Construction Coolies' Mutual Aid Society
------------------

Secret information has been received to the effect
that the badges of Coolies Nos.170 and 179 attached to the
Soochow Road Depot were withheld by Messrs. McLellan and
Hayler and the two coolies were thus compelled to suspend
work. As a consequence the workers in that district are
now contemplating a "tai-kung" strike as a protest.

It is unfortunate that the services of these two
coolies were terminated without fault on their part. The
Council having declared that it has no intention of reducing
staff, the withdrawal of the badges of the coolies may
possibly be accounted for in some other way.

Coolies should work as usual pending negtoations
by this Association with the authorities.

上海公共租界筑路苦力互助会第3号通知
------------------

接获秘密消息，称苏州路（Soochow Road）堆栈所属的第170号和第179号苦力的工作证被麦克莱伦（McLellan）和海勒（Hayler）两位先生扣留，导致这两名苦力被迫停工。因此，该地区的工人正考虑举行“怠工”罢工以示抗议。

不幸的是，这两名苦力在无过错的情况下被终止服务。既然工部局已声明无意裁员，扣留苦力证的行为可能有其他解释。

在本会与当局进行谈判期间，苦力应照常工作。

TRANSLATION

Draft of an agreement between the road construction
foremen (Brass and Iron badges) and coolies of the
International Public Works Department.

--------

Because we, both foremen and coolies, are of the
labour class and have close working relations, we should aid
each other so that we will both live in prosperity. With
this aim in view, we decided to organize a mutual aid society
to promote our welfare. Hereafter both foremen and coolies
will maintain a united front.

The following terms are agreed upon by representatives
of both sides; any one side or individual who fails to observe
this agreement will be dealt with by the Society.

Art. 1. During working hours, coolies should follow the
directions of the foremen, while the latter should
behave properly towards the coolies. Each should
do his duty diligently.

Art. 2. After working hours, both foremen and coolies enjoy
equality, no jealousy should exist between them.

Art. 3. When a coolie is lazy or behaves badly, the foreman
should not report it to his senior, but should note
the number and name of the coolie concerned and
report to the Society through the representative
(? of the foremen). The society will give advice
to the coolies or punish him.

Art. 4. The coolies should not report to their seniors
(ranks higher than foreman) any embezzlement, illegal
act, or other breach of regulations, committed by
their foremen.

Art. 5. If foremen are guilty of oppressions, the coolies
should not open direct negotiations with their
foremen but should report the matter to the Society.
The society, on receiving the report, will investigate
the case and punish, if necessary, the foreman
concerned.

Art. 6. If the S.M.C. authorities oppress the foremen, the
coolies should afford them, the foremen, their
wholehearted support.

Art. 7. If the S.M.C. authorities oppress the coolies, the
foremen should afford them, the coolies, their
wholehearted support.

Art. 8. The coolies and foremen should support each other
at all times.
page_data.zh:
译文

国际公共工部局筑路领班（铜牌和铁牌）与苦力之间的协议草案。

--------

鉴于我们领班和苦力均属劳工阶层，且工作关系密切，我们应互相帮助，以便共同过上富裕生活。本着这一目标，我们决定组织一个互助会以促进我们的福利。今后，领班和苦力将保持统一战线。

以下条款经双方代表同意；任何一方或个人若不遵守本协议，将由本会处理。

第1条. 工作时间内，苦力应服从领班的指挥，而领班应对苦力行为得体。各方均应勤勉尽职。

第2条. 工作时间结束后，领班和苦力享有平等地位，彼此间不应存在嫉妒。

第3条. 若苦力懒惰或行为不端，领班不应向其上级报告，而应记下相关苦力的编号和姓名，并通过代表（?领班代表）向本会报告。本会将劝告苦力或对其进行处罚。

第4条. 苦力不得向其上级（职位高于领班者）报告其领班犯有的贪污、违法行为或其他违规行为。

第5条. 若领班有欺压行为，苦力不应直接与领班交涉，而应向本会报告。本会在接到报告后将调查此案，并在必要时处罚相关领班。

第6条. 若工部局当局欺压领班，苦力应全心全意支持领班。

第7条. 若工部局当局欺压苦力，领班应全心全意支持苦力。

第8条. 苦力和领班应随时互相支持。

page_data.en:
I
- 2 -
Art. 9 The foremen and coolies should support their
leader and obey him.
Art. 10. The foremen and coolies should strictly adhere to
and support the regulations of the Society.
Art. 11. The foremen and coolies will reject exploitation
by any party, or clique.
Art. 12. Should any one failé to observe this agreement,
it will be regarded as a sign that he is willing
to forfeit his qualifications as a coolie or
foreman and is willing receive punishment from
his colleagues.
Art. 13. There are altogether three copies of this agreement;
one is kept by the representative of the foremen,
one by the representative of the coolies and the
remaining one by the Society.
page_data.zh:
I
- 2 -
第9条 领班和苦力应支持其领袖并服从他。
第10条. 领班和苦力应严格遵守并支持本会的规章。
第11条. 领班和苦力将拒绝任何党派或团体的剥削。
第12条. 若有人未能遵守本协议，将被视为愿意放弃其作为苦力或领班的资格，并愿意接受同事的处罚。
第13条. 本协议共三份；一份由领班代表保管，一份由苦力代表保管，剩余一份由本会保管。

At 4.30 p.m. March 2, 1937, six P.W.D. road construction coolies named Li Ching-teung (李景春), Liu Kwan-wen (劉煥文), Kwan Boo-yung (環步瀛), Wong Lih-sung (王立生) and Sun, Boong-yuen (沈仲元), in company with Chen Kiu-feng (陳九峰), their principal adviser, called at the San Teh Steamship Company, 93 Canton Road. At 5.30 p.m. Mr. Yu Ya Ching, Chinese councillor of the S.M.C., interviewed the representatives and informed them that the S.M.C. had already made concessions to the coolies by agreeing to issue half wages for rainy days and full wages for New Year holidays. With regard to the question of the exchange of badges, Mr. Yu Ya Ching stated that he would negotiate further with the Council. In conclusion, he asked the delegates to write down any further requests which they desired to put forward. Chen Kiu-feng then submitted the following written requests :-
1. The badges of road construction coolies and the sewerage coolies should be different.
2. The total number of road construction coolies attached to the Shunteh Road Depot is only 191, and yet some 401 new badges were issued when the exchange of badges took place sometime ago. Consequently the sewerage coolies must have been included with the road construction coolies. This inclusion will inevitably lead to confusion and trouble in future.
3. All road construction coolies should be given a cap bearing a number.
4. In view of the recent reported dismissal of 42 foremen of road construction coolies, the coolies fear they may suffer the same fate in the future.
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE - 3 MAR 1937）

The S.M.C. Road Constructions Coolies' Mutual
Aid Society, which has offices in the Ting Tsz Club (同子社),

Lane 351 Elgin Road.

the coolies, will, in a few days, take up residence in the new
offices of the Society.

P.W.D. depots met at this new address when Chen Kiu Feng
